desc:: This is the config for the chunk sending mod, it is mostly relevant for dedicated servers. A Tick in minecraft happens 20 times a second(20TPS), a chunk is a 16x16 block area that gets sent to the client.

maxChunksPerTick.desc:: Maximum amount of chunks sent per tick to a player. Default: 15 (x3 in singleplayer)

maxChunksPerTickAll.desc:: Maximum amount of chunks sent per tick globally for all players(equally split, minimum 1 per tick). Reduces the network impact of multiple players joining at once. Default: 80

prioritizeDirection.desc:: Enables chunks to prioritize loading in the direction the player is facing. Default: true

cacheChunkPackets.desc:: Enables chunk packets to be re-used to send to multiple players instead of creating new ones. Especially useful for many players on a server. Disable if you're having mod compat issues,  Default: true

ItemFrameMaps.desc:: Settings for Item Frames containing maps sending updates to players. Default: enabled = true, set to false to disable this feature.
ItemFrameMaps.desc2:: Sets the update interval at which itemframes send map updates to ALL players in a dimension, so reducing the update rate does reduce network traffic especially when a lot of itemframes with maps exist. Default: 100 Ticks, Vanilla: 10 Ticks
ItemFrameMaps.desc3:: Sets the update interval at which itemframes send map updates to nearby players. Default: 20 Ticks, Vanilla: 10 Ticks

debugLogging.desc:: Enable debug logging to show the amount of chunks sent/queued
